care.title: A little care. A lot of green.
care.lead: Find a sunny corner, slow down, and let something grow. A few simple habits make your plants feel at home.
care.lightBody: Most indoor plants enjoy bright, indirect light. Keep delicate leaves away from harsh afternoon sun and turn the pot occasionally for even growth.
care.waterBody: Check the soil before reaching for the watering can. Let the top layer dry between drinks, and always let excess water drain away.
care.spaceBody: Choose a pot with drainage, wipe dusty leaves gently, and look for roots crowding the pot. Repot when your plant needs a little more space.

contact.title: Let's keep it growing.
contact.lead: Looking for your first plant or caring for a growing collection? Start with the answers below, explore our care guide, or join our plant updates.
contact.q1: How do I choose my first plant?
contact.a1: Start with the light and space in your room. Browse the collection, open a plant's details and choose one whose care needs fit your routine.
contact.q2: Where can I find plant care advice?
contact.a2: Our care guide covers light, watering and room to grow. Each product page also includes its own description to help you choose.
contact.q3: How do I keep track of plants I like?
contact.a3: Add available plants to your bag. Your selection stays in this browser, and you can change quantities or remove plants at any time.
contact.updatesBody: Leave your email for plant news and collection updates.
